title: Ride se pehle tip? 10 lakh ka fine!
voice: ElevenLabs Bunty – Punchy, Crisp and Reel King (website, Eleven v4)
lines: [curious] Cab dhoondh rahe the... app bola: tip do, jaldi milegi!
Tip toh ride ke BAAD hoti hai!
[sarcastic] Ola ne naam badla... tip se add-on!
Twist? Add-on wali rides KAM accept hui!
Sarkar ne thoka 10 lakh ka fine.
Aise aur raaz ke liye... follow karo!
caption:
Cab search ho rahi thi aur app pe likha aaya: "Tip now to boost the chances of getting a ride sooner"... matlab tip do, cab jaldi milegi! 🚕💸

Sach: Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) ne ise dark pattern maana aur Ola (ANI Technologies) pe ₹10 lakh ka fine lagaya (13 Nov 2026).

Raaz kya tha:
• Prompt tab aata tha jab app driver dhoondh raha hota hai, yaani jab tum sabse zyada jaldi me ho. Pre-set amount ₹10-40 se badh ke ₹140 tak pahunch gaye.
• Motor Vehicle Aggregator Guidelines 2025: tip sirf ride ke BAAD, apni marzi se, aur poori tip driver ko.
• CCPA ne 2025 me hi rokne ko kaha tha, par Ola ne feature hataya nahi, bas 'tip' ka naam 'add-on' kar diya.
• Twist: Ola ke apne data (1-15 June 2026) me add-on wali ride requests ko driveron ne bina add-on wali requests se bhi KAM accept kiya. Ye customers ko bataya nahi gaya.

Ab Ola ko ride se pehle wale saare tip/add-on prompts hatane honge.

Tumne kabhi ride se pehle tip di hai? Comment karo 👇
